tool.name: Get.otulist
tool.description: Get otus for each distance in a otu list
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("sort=" + str($sort))
echo 'get.otulist(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: label - select OTU distance labels
param.help: By default, uses all if none are selected.

param.label: sort - select the output format
param.help: If otu is selected the output will be otu number followed by the list of names in that otu. If name is selected the output will be a sequence name followed by its otu number

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.otulist_ command parses a list file and returns one dataset per distance in the ``OTUs per label`` collection, each containing 2 columns. The first column is the OTU number the second column is a list of sequences in that OTU.
.. _get.otulist: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.otulist/
